topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my college application essay, untouched, on a dusty corner of the internet. There it was, my words, my hopes, my story, laid out for anyone to see. It was like finding an old photograph of a moment you thought was private. The irony is, I poured my heart into every sentence, believing it would lead to a new beginning. Instead, it seems to have become a mere example, something for others to dissect, perhaps even mock. I can’t help but wonder if the effort, the sincerity, meant anything at all. It’s just another reminder of how easily the things we hold dear can become trivial in the eyes of others.
